hero.name: Andrew Smithies
hero.description: After a career teaching mathematics, I now design and build web and mobile applications where analytical thinking, clarity, and user‑focused design come together.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a former mathematics teacher who transitioned into web and mobile development, where my analytical mindset and love of problem-solving found a natural home.
about.paragraph2: Teaching taught me to break down complex ideas, communicate clearly, and approach challenges with structure and patience—skills I now apply to designing and building applications.
about.paragraph3: Today I work with modern tools like React Native, TypeScript, Symfony and Vue.js to create reliable, maintainable applications with thoughtful user experiences.
